description_zh: 一辆丰田SUV（ego）在Embarcadero St直行时，追尾前方同车道因红灯停止的WeRide自动驾驶车（v1）。ego作为移动且具测试价值的后车，测试其能否及时刹停。

source_snippets: At 1:54pm, a WeRide vehicle (Car 1) was stopped on Embarcadero St left turning lane to Howard St. As our vehicle (Car 1) was stopped for red traffic light, the toyota suv (Car 2) approaching from behind collided with our vehicle (Car 1).
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: VEH 1: A. STOPPED; VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 1: C. REAR END; VEH 2: A. HEAD-ON
evidence.reason: Car 2（移动、直行）作为ego，Car 1（静止、同车道前方）作为NPC，符合stopped_ahead与straight的组合，碰撞为ego追尾v1，控制信号为红灯。
